newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Lepanto B surges 6.78 pct on gold project.
newsitem.headline: Lepanto B surges 6.78 pct on gold project.

text.p: Lepanto Consolidated Mining Co B shares jumped in late trade on Thursday by eight centavos, or 6.78 percent, to 1.26 pesos on talk that it will soon start the production of its recent gold find, brokers said.

"It's the issue on their gold discovery. There's talk that production will soon start, the gold is of high quality and the life of the mine may be longer than expected," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Citisecurities Inc.
Lepanto has sought tax incentives from the Board of Investments to pursue a 1.94-billion peso development of a new gold ore deposit.
A Lepanto official said the gold project in the northern province of Benguet was started recently but could not give further details.
Previously, the company said the project would start in June.
Lepanto A shares also gained ground in late trade, rising by three centavos, or 3.45 percent, to 90 pesos.
Both A and B shares of the mining firm were the second and third most heavily traded in mid-session.
